manifest.name: Search Box
manifest.description: Labeled search entry with keyboard shortcut hint, submit action, and pending affordance. Emits the submitted query upward; the host performs the search and feeds pending state back in.
manifest.solves: Users need one obvious, fast entry point to find things without learning the information architecture first.
appliesWhen: Content exceeds what a user will scan
A downstream view consumes a query (results table, filtered list)

do: Keep the label visible - placeholder-only search fields fail recall
Emit the query upward; never fetch inside the composite
never: Multiple search boxes competing for attention on one view
Auto-search on every keystroke without a pending affordance
